title: How I Make $100k/month Using Claude Code (full guide)
key_points: The creator built a complete VSL funnel using Claude Code that generates $100k/month, replacing an old Go HighLevel funnel that had generated over $1 million
The funnel includes Meta and Google tracking that fires events at 5%, 10%, 25%, 50%, 75%, and 95% VSL watch marks back to the ad platforms for optimization
Wistia (referred to as Viddalyzer) is used for VSL hosting, providing statistics on where viewers unmute, mute, pause, stop watching, and leave the page
Microsoft Clarity is integrated for free heatmapping and session recordings with API access that Claude Code can use to analyze funnel data

The opt-in form is a Go HighLevel survey embedded via iframe, which disqualifies leads who don't meet criteria (under $25k/month or don't generate Instagram leads) and prevents those unqualified events from firing to Meta
Claude Code scraped Instagram profile pictures and follower counts from client accounts to create Instagram-style profile cards, which can be updated via prompt

The wall of love testimonial section was built by giving Claude Code access to a Notion board containing mixed content (Fathom snippets, Loom videos, screenshots, raw videos) which it downloaded, transcribed, and trimmed automatically
The FAQ section was generated by Claude Code analyzing hundreds of sales calls via Fathom API to identify most asked questions and common objections
Three different color versions (gold, purple, blue) were created simultaneously, and the blue version was selected based on partner feedback
The funnel is hosted on Vercel with GitHub repo integration, all set up by Claude Code
A custom dashboard was built integrating Google Analytics, Meta Ads, Microsoft Clarity, Wistia analytics, and Vercel analytics into one view
Four closes from eight showed calls in the first 1-2 weeks, with minimum yearly LTV of $30,000 per client ($120,000+ total value)
Step 1 of the process: Research other VSL funnels first and give Claude Code the links to analyze them using Playwright browser contextually, visually, and code-wise
Step 2: Build multiple versions simultaneously in different styles, then choose one before going deep into development
Step 3: Use overnight prompts for long tasks like full smoke QA tests, speed optimization, tracking tests, and image processing that can run for 1-2 hours
Step 4: Use Playwright browser skill so Claude Code can visually verify its work with screenshots rather than only checking code
A 'create plan' custom skill is used to generate comprehensive testing plans for overnight runs
The entire funnel took a couple of days working part-time; estimated one day if working full-time
Daily briefings are generated by Claude Opus 4 using all connected API responses
summary:
The video demonstrates a complete VSL funnel built entirely with Claude Code for Omnifusion AI, an agency that builds automated sales systems for high-ticket coaches on Instagram. The creator shows a comparison between their old Go HighLevel funnel (simple headline, VSL, form, three testimonials) which generated over $1 million, and the new custom-coded funnel built for running Facebook ads where optimization, speed, and tracking accuracy become critical.

The funnel structure includes: a headline addressing pain points (leads going cold, slow DM replies, no shows), a Wistia-hosted VSL with detailed view tracking at multiple percentage marks (5%, 10%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 95%) that fire back to Meta and Google pixels, animated CTAs styled with brand colors copied from other funnels, and Instagram-style client profile cards with scraped profile pictures and follower counts. The opt-in form is a Go HighLevel survey embedded via iframe that qualifies leads based on Instagram lead generation and $25k+/month revenue, automatically redirecting unqualified leads to a waitlist page to prevent those conversions from training Meta's algorithm.

Additional sections include a comparison table (human setters vs Omnifusion system), a reputation section featuring industry leader Liam Botley, six video testimonials that Claude Code downloaded and trimmed automatically, a how-it-works section, and a wall of love section built from a Notion board containing mixed media (Fathom clips, Loom videos, screenshots, raw videos) that Claude Code accessed, transcribed, and processed. The FAQ section was generated by Claude Code analyzing hundreds of sales calls through Fathom API to extract actual questions and objections from real leads.

The technical implementation includes Microsoft Clarity integration for free session recordings and heatmaps with API access, hosting on Vercel with automatic GitHub deployment, and mobile optimization with near-instant load times. A separate custom dashboard was built combining Google Analytics, Meta Ads, Clarity, Wistia, and Vercel analytics. The creator receives daily briefings from Claude Opus 4 that aggregate all API data.

The four-step methodology is: (1) research existing funnels and have Claude Code analyze them via Playwright browser before building, (2) create multiple style versions simultaneously then choose one early, (3) prepare overnight prompts for long-running tasks like QA testing and image processing using a custom 'create plan' skill, and (4) always use Playwright browser for visual verification rather than code-only checks. The project involved 50 GitHub commits over several days of part-time work, with results showing four closes from eight shown calls in the first 1-2 weeks at $30,000+ minimum yearly LTV per client.
